decision.rationale: Issue #550 adds generic durable receipt replay, exact identity and byte parity, and thin entry delegation. App-owned policy remains outside agentic_core; pre-existing app-named adapters are bounded by an expiring migration receipt.

spine_substrate_test.evidence: Canonical product facade begins at signed FRESH_PREFLIGHT and delegates generic runtime stages.

any_app_capability_test.evidence: L4 durability and L6 parity consume generic identity, receipt, digest, and observation contracts.

app_owned_meaning_test.evidence: Producer, product, evaluator, and scorecard semantics remain in apps_research, apps_rg, and apps_eval.

no_app_literal_test.evidence: Changed-path GOV-3 scan has zero unbaselined findings.

plugin_test.evidence: App integrations exercise generic core through app-owned adapters without new core branching.

negative_control_test.evidence: Failure matrix covers all 26 authority stages and security tamper controls fail closed.

platform_approval_test.evidence: User explicitly authorized Waves 1-6, branch commits, and push.

boundary_preservation_test.evidence: Boundary receipt classifies all changed core files and binds app-named adapters to an expiry.

contract_compatibility_test.evidence: Authority freeze and 29-requirement structural traceability both pass.

runtime_proof_compatibility_test.evidence: Focused runtime finality, Apps Eval purity, and L6 parity suites pass.
